items.text: Career options for housewives and stay-at-home mothers in India include flexible remote work, tutoring, content and design, small home-based ventures, part-time roles and structured return programmes, and the best choice depends on your time, skills and the support you can arrange.
Work-from-home offers that ask for fees or promise high pay for simple tasks are common scams.
high income opportunities come from finished work in one lane.
